Container.Name: diary
Container.Overview: Charlie - Life Journal. Password-protected writing, life chapters, prompts, photos, voice notes, and memories. Complete first-run password setup on your trusted network. Enable Unraid Tailscale Serve for private HTTPS access; leave Funnel disabled.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Host port. The container and Tailscale Serve use internal port 3000.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent journal, attachments, password, and Tailscale state. Keep this share on your cache pool.

Config.Name: App User ID
Config.Description: Unraid nobody UID. Startup drops app privileges after the Tailscale hook.

Config.Name: HTTPS-only cookies
Config.Description: Set true after switching exclusively to Tailscale HTTPS; HTTP LAN login then stops working.

Config.Name: Canonical app origin
Config.Description: Optional exact HTTPS origin if a reverse proxy rewrites Host. Otherwise leave blank.
